portability_test.predictor: held-out system uses the same family's mean rho across all other traits
portability_test.baseline: global mean rho across all systems from traits other than the held-out trait
portability_test.null: within each trait independently permute rho among fixed family labels

shared_randomization: Generate one set of within-trait permutation maps and reuse exactly for S3 and prune-only.
hard_nonclaims: Do not infer family effects dominate trait effects.
Do not reinterpret conditional family repeatability threshold.
Do not remove systems after seeing prediction errors.
